summary: Frontend-only test of the v1.7.1 year-rename 'Never rename' list, using the simulated electronAPI harness. New suite /app/tests/test_iter47_rename_ignore.py: run_ignore 33/33 PASS, run_prune 7/7 PASS. Confirmed: (1) In a dialog with 4 rows, Never rename on Heat removes the row at once. Heat's checkbox is not toggled, and the unticked TEST_Third stays unticked while the other rows stay ticked. The toast reads 'Heat (1996).mkv will not be suggested for renaming again'. obsidian_cinema_year_rename_ignored holds the Heat path, obsidian_cinema_year_mismatches no longer has heat, the chip drops from 4 to 3, the footer shows '1 file is set to never rename · Allow again', and the button reads 'Rename 2 files'. (2) Rename calls the renameFile mock only for the ticked rows (Second, Fourth). Second fails and stays listed; Fourth is renamed; the chip shows 2. (3) After a reload the chip still shows 2 and the ignore list is still stored. (4) After making Heat need a rating again and re-running Fix, Heat was looked up again (movie/949) but did not come back in the dialog or the stored list. (5) Allow again shows the toast, clears the ignore list and hides the link. (6) Seeding one live, one deleted and one moved entry gives a chip of 1, and the stored list is pruned to [heat]. With an empty library the stored list keeps all 3 entries and no chip shows. Regression iter44 run_fix_manual: all checks pass. No page errors.

integration_issues.flow: Fix missing info toast after a run
integration_issues.issue: In runFixMissing (LocalLibraryPage.jsx ~line 1777) the toast counts mismatches.length, which includes files on the ignore list. Reproduced: with Heat ignored, a re-run toasted '... · 1 file names differ in year' while no new mismatch was added. Use keep.length instead. The same check also opens the dialog (setShowMismatches) when every mismatch is ignored. The dialog then shows only old entries, or nothing.

issues: Grammar: '1 file names differ in year' and 'Filled 1 ratings' when the count is 1. The chip already handles the singular.

action_items: LocalLibraryPage.jsx runFixMissing: count keep.length (not mismatches.length) in the toast, and only open the dialog when keep.length > 0
Optional: use the singular in the fill toast ('1 file name differs', '1 rating')
critical_code_review_comments: The ignore list matches on file_path only. A file that is moved or renamed outside the app gets suggested again. This is probably fine and matches the spec.

The prune effect depends on libraryReady = movies.length > 0. If the library loads in stages, entries for titles that have not loaded yet could be pruned too early. The current single-shot load is fine.
The Never rename button sits inside the <label>. It uses preventDefault + stopPropagation, so the checkbox is not toggled (verified).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of feature checks (40/40); one minor toast-count bug found by inspecting the output

seed_data_creation: None in real data. Tests run in isolated browser contexts with seeded sessionStorage/localStorage. No physical files touched (renameFile is mocked).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: g={'page':page}; exec(open('/app/tests/test_iter47_rename_ignore.py').read(), g); await g['run_ignore'](); await g['run_prune'](). The file loads iter44 helpers through exec. The 'OBS: fill toast mismatch count excludes ignored' check is too weak and passes falsely. The re-run toast actually said '1 file names differ in year' with only the ignored Heat as the mismatch. Tighten it to assert that no 'differ in year' text appears once the toast-count fix lands.
